descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
SPACE JUMP is a first-person platformer built for VR comfort.

You start in orbit above a red planet, on a floating outpost. The islands ahead stretch away into space, and the only way forward is to run and jump.

TEN WORLDS
Red Planet Outpost, Ice Moon Relay, Lava Fields, Emerald Reach, Golden Dunes, Amethyst Drift, Ocean World, Steel Belt, Toxic Garden and the Star Core. Each has its own planet below, its own sky and its own colours.

A JUMP THAT FEELS GOOD IN VR
One long, soft arc every time. No snapping, no stomach drop. Walk with the stick, snap turn, jump with A. Nothing can kill you: miss a landing and you hop back to the last checkpoint.

THINGS TO RIDE
Cargo drones carry you over the long gaps. Elevators lift you to the high decks. A monorail flatcar runs the canyon, and gravity lifts fling you up to islands you cannot reach any other way.

WATCH OUT
Cracked asteroids sink a second after you land. Laser fences sweep the decks at knee height, so jump them. Aliens patrol the paths and you can stomp them flat.

LONGER AND FASTER
Level one is a 200 metre warm-up. By level ten you are crossing half a kilometre, moving quicker, over narrower platforms and longer gaps.

THE FINALE
On the Star Core, step onto the rocket's launch pad and it takes you with it, climbing into the stars with the whole level shrinking below.
